non_regression_rules.rule: A visible scenario must not disappear.
A functional station must not lose its protected data.
A protected timeseries must not lose measurement volume.
Runtime reaches and subbasins must not decrease without validation.
SWAT daily, monthly, yearly datasets must remain distinct.
Map layers must not lose features.
Protected business statistics must not change without a documented cause.
Protected endpoints must not break their contract.
Every future data correction must be compared to this baseline.
If a protected regression is detected: immediate rollback.
